segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Hey, quick sanity check on Northlake. They want the renewal proposal today, 38 seats, start date March 1, and they asked for the two-year option at the same time.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yeah, I saw the note. Are they keeping the analytics add-on, or did Melissa back off that?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Keeping it, but only for 12 of the seats. Base package for all 38, analytics for 12, support stays standard. Total is coming out to $54,720 for year one before tax.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay. Any discount above the normal renewal band?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Just 8 percent. The annoying part is I had to enter the same seat split, March 1 date, discount, and billing contact in the CRM, the pricing sheet, the billing tool, and then the deal desk form, so it ate most of yesterday afternoon and this morning.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Got it. Deal desk should be fine at 8 percent. Did you set net 30, or are they asking for net 45 again?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Net 30. Their procurement person tried for 45, but Melissa said finance approved 30 if we keep the annual invoice under 55K.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Good. Send me the PDF before it goes out. I’ll check the service dates and the add-on language, then you can get it to them before 3.
